in_sanskrit.name: धरिनी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who holds, supports or maintains something. In Hindu mythology, Dharini is a name of Goddess Parvati, the consort of Lord Shiva, who is considered to be the supporter and sustainer of the universe.

in_hindi.name: धरिनी
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who holds or supports. In Sanskrit, the word धरना (dharanā) means to hold or support. In Hindi, the name Dharini is derived from this Sanskrit root.

in_tamil.name: தரினி
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who holds or sustains. In Tamil, the word தற்குவில்லை (taraḻkuviḻṟai) means the one who holds or sustains.

in_telugu.name: ధరినీ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who holds or supports. In Telugu, the word ధరద్దే (dharaḻḏḇē) means the one who holds or supports.

in_marathi.name: Dharini
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who holds, maintains, or supports the universe. Derived from the Sanskrit root dhri, meaning to uphold, this name carries a deep spiritual significance in Hindu culture.

in_bengali.name: Dharini
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Holder, Supporter
in_bengali.long_meaning: Dharini একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who holds, maintains, or supports the universe. Derived from the Sanskrit root dhri, meaning to uphold, this name carries a deep spiritual significance in Hindu culture.
